verdict.rationale: OpenClaw explicitly documents running itself as an MCP server via `openclaw mcp serve`, and a probe confirms the docs page exists, which flips the usual agent-role 'na' exception since the product ships an actual server mode. This also complements OpenClaw's separate MCP-client capability (connecting to other MCP servers), showing full agentic interoperability. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that external agents successfully connect to this server (only first-party docs and a page-existence probe, no community usage report).
